completion_data.completion_summary: Completed Phase 5 (the plan's final phase): reinstalled the edited writer to $HOME/.claude/scripts/setup-sapience-mcp.sh, backed up and migrated all 6 registered ~/.claude.json project entries off the raw Sapience token, re-confirmed authentication with SAPIENCE_TOKEN absent, confirmed verify-sapience-mcp.sh check (b) passes and its 58-case regression suite (including the sentinel-token negative control) passes in full, removed the plaintext backup, and redeployed cleanly. Task 682 is now fully implemented across all 5 phases. Flagged a new security finding during migration: the writer's own divergence diagnostic printed the live token in cleartext to this dispatch's own tool-output transcript -- recorded via issue-record.sh and surfaced via user_decision for token-rotation judgment.

memory_candidates.content: `env -i HOME="$HOME" python3 ...` fails with 'python3: No such file or directory' (exit 127): env -i clears PATH along with every other variable, so a bare interpreter name cannot be resolved. Fix: resolve the absolute interpreter path first (`command -v python3`, or inherit a known nix-store-pinned path) and invoke THAT absolute path under env -i. Useful for any 'simulate a stripped environment' probe (e.g. confirming a program falls back to a config file when an env var is unset).

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience per-project ~/.claude.json entries migrated off the raw bearer token
sapience_notes.value: All 6 registered project entries on this machine (.dotfiles, the nvim config repo, BimodalLogic, sf1-engine, sapience-app, sapience-pitch) were migrated from env.SAPIENCE_TOKEN-bearing entries to a token-free shape (SAPIENCE_HOST only). Authentication is unaffected: ~/.sapience/mcp.py already resolves the token from ~/.sapience/config.json at import time regardless of the environment variable, confirmed via the --statusline and stdio initialize probes run under env -i post-migration.

sapience_notes.subject: setup-sapience-mcp.sh's own divergence diagnostic prints a live token value in cleartext
sapience_notes.value: The writer's non-quiet 'diverges from the sanctioned shape' message prints the full current-entry JSON, including env.SAPIENCE_TOKEN's raw value, to stdout whenever an already-registered entry differs from the canonical shape. Driving the writer over a still-token-bearing entry (which a migration necessarily does, once per entry) leaks the live token into whatever captures that stdout, including an agent's own tool-output transcript. Not yet redacted; flagged as a new exposure surface and a candidate token-rotation trigger.

sapience_notes.subject: A regression test's fixture-based negative control can discharge a later live-verification step
sapience_notes.value: A migration phase's 'confirm the verifier fails on a regression' requirement was discharged by re-running an earlier phase's existing fixture-based test cases (a hand-built sentinel token, never the real one) rather than hand-rolling a second throwaway fixture against the live config file -- avoiding any need to transiently reintroduce a real secret into production state just to prove the negative path.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience token homes on this machine are consistently owner-only
sapience_notes.value: Re-confirmed across ~/.sapience/config.json, its 3 timestamped backups, ~/.config/sf1-hub-ben/{env,sapience-token}, ~/.claude.json itself, and /run/secrets/sapience_token: every one is 0600 or 0400, owner-only, none world-readable. ~/.dotfiles/secrets/secrets.yaml is the sole git-tracked location and is sops-encrypted.

sapience_notes.subject: env -i strips PATH, not just application-level variables
sapience_notes.value: A probe built as `env -i HOME="$HOME" python3 <script>` fails with exit 127 ('python3: No such file or directory') because env -i clears PATH along with every other variable; resolving the interpreter to an absolute path first and invoking that under env -i fixes it. Relevant any time a 'does this program still work with env var X unset' probe is built with env -i rather than env -u X.

user_decision.summary: This phase's live migration run leaked the configured Sapience token in cleartext into this dispatch's own Bash tool-output stream (6 times, once per migrated project entry) -- a transcript-exposure vector the task itself exists to close, surfaced by a diagnostic line in setup-sapience-mcp.sh that was outside this phase's declared file list to fix. The user should decide whether to rotate the Sapience token now given this exposure, and whether to authorize a fast-follow task to redact that diagnostic's printed value. Recorded via issue-record.sh (kind: issue, severity: blocking) without re-printing the token; full detail in the summary's Follow-ups section.
